title: StripeCheckout
description: supabase/functions/stripe-checkout/index.ts. Authenticated. Creates a Stripe Checkout session for a subscription (mode=subscription) and returns its hosted URL — the client opens this in the system default browser (NSWorkspace.shared.open on macOS; Process.Start on Windows), it does NOT embed Stripe Elements or collect card details itself. client_reference_id and metadata.user_id are both set to the caller's verified user id (never client-supplied) so the stripe-webhook handler can attribute the resulting subscription to the right profiles row. success_url/cancel_url are hardcoded to https://getmira.today (not configurable per-request) — a Windows-specific web destination may need its own decision if the marketing site's post-checkout UX differs by platform.

plan.title: StripeCheckoutPlan
plan.description: Any value other than "ultra" is treated as "pro" server-side (the function does plan === "ultra" ? PRICE_ULTRA : PRICE_PRO with no explicit validation error for a bad value) — this is a looseness in the current source, not a documented contract guarantee.

error.description: Either unauthenticated (thrown by requireUser) or Stripe's own session.error.message forwarded through on a Stripe API failure (400).
